novel_features.name: Overdue tasks across portal
novel_features.description: List tasks whose end_date is in the past but status isn't 'closed'/'completed'.
novel_features.rationale: Joins tasks × projects locally — no native portal-wide overdue view; existing ZohoProjects UI filters are per-project.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this for daily standup — who's behind on which projects, in one shot.

novel_features.name: Stale projects detector
novel_features.description: Active projects with no task activity in N days.
novel_features.rationale: Joins projects × tasks locally — Zoho's portal stats only show counts, not last-activity recency.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this in weekly portfolio review to find projects that have lost momentum.

novel_features.name: Workload by owner
novel_features.description: Open tasks + issues per user with mean/stddev/Gini across the portal.
novel_features.rationale: Local group-by on owner_id across tasks AND issues — no native combined view.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this for sprint planning — surfaces who's stretched across multiple projects.

novel_features.name: Conversational FTS
novel_features.description: Search task names/descriptions, issue titles/descriptions, project names/descriptions locally.
novel_features.rationale: SQLite FTS5 over locally-synced content — Zoho's search is module-scoped and rate-limited.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to recall the right ticket/task without paginating per-module search endpoints.

novel_features.name: Issue heat map by project
novel_features.description: Per-project open-issue counts grouped by severity, surfacing projects with concentrated bugs.
novel_features.rationale: Groups locally by project_id + severity; no native portal heat-map exists.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this in monthly QA review to find projects accumulating critical issues.

novel_features.name: Project burn (planned vs actual)
novel_features.description: Per-project completed-task ratio with projected completion date based on 4-week velocity.
novel_features.rationale: Computes velocity from tasks.last_modified_time + percent_complete locally; no native projection.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to call out projects likely to slip end-dates before the customer notices.

novel_features.name: Unassigned items radar
novel_features.description: Open tasks and issues with no owner across active projects.
novel_features.rationale: Joins tasks + issues locally where owner is empty — common project-hygiene gap.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this Friday afternoon to clean up orphaned work before the weekend.

novel_features.name: My focus today
novel_features.description: Tasks + issues assigned to the authenticated user across all portals, ranked by due date.
novel_features.rationale: Joins tasks × issues × users locally; surfaces top-N items the user needs to touch today.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this every morning to plan the day without clicking through every project board.

narrative.headline: Every Zoho Projects API endpoint, plus portal-wide insights (overdue, stale, workload, issue heat) no native view supports.
narrative.value_prop: Full coverage of Zoho Projects portals, projects, tasks, task-lists, phases, issues, and users — plus FTS5 over locally-synced content, portal-wide overdue/stale detection, workload fairness, project burn projection, and unassigned-items radar. Built on a synced local SQLite store so PMs and team leads can plan without clicking through every project board.
narrative.auth_narrative: Zoho Projects uses OAuth 2.0. You need a self-client refresh token, client ID/secret, and your portal ID. Set ZOHOPROJECTS_REFRESH_TOKEN, ZOHOPROJECTS_CLIENT_ID, ZOHOPROJECTS_CLIENT_SECRET, ZOHOPROJECTS_PORTAL_ID — or run `zoho-projects-pp-cli auth set-token` to store them. The CLI auto-refreshes access tokens.

quickstart.comment: Validates OAuth creds + portal_id + API reachability.
Populates SQLite with all portals, projects, tasks, issues, users.
Top 10 items assigned to you, ranked by due date.

troubleshoots.fix: Re-run `zoho-projects-pp-cli auth set-token` with a fresh self-client refresh token from accounts.zoho.com/developerconsole. Scopes needed: ZohoProjects.portals.READ, projects.READ, tasks.ALL, bugs.ALL.
Check ZOHOPROJECTS_PORTAL_ID matches a portal the token has access to. `zoho-projects-pp-cli portals list --json` lists every portal your token can see.
Zoho Projects limits to ~10 req/s per org. The CLI retries with backoff; for large initial syncs use `sync --concurrency 1`.
FTS index is populated by `sync`. Run `sync --resources tasks,issues,projects` first.

narrative.when_to_use: Reach for zoho-projects-pp-cli when you need to plan or report across projects — portal-wide overdue/stale/workload views, cross-project search, project burn projection, and unassigned-items cleanup. For one-off CRUD operations on a single ticket or task, the API or MCP is fine; use this CLI when local cache, FTS, or cross-project joins matter.
